violations.message: Octal constant '017' used. Octal constants and escape sequences shall not be used.
violations.reason: The integer literal '017' is specified in octal notation. MISRA Rule 7.1 prohibits octal constants because the leading zero can easily be misread or cause unintended base-8 interpretations.
